resources.string: Check light flicker with your phone
The app estimates flicker frequency and modulation using the main camera. Results depend on the camera and conditions and are not a certified measurement.
The camera is used only for live analysis. Images and results are not saved or sent anywhere.
Point the camera at a white matte surface illuminated by the lamp.

1. Leave only the tested lamp on.

2. Use a white or light-gray matte surface without glare.

3. Hold the phone 20–50 cm away and fill the frame.

4. Keep the phone still for 4 seconds.

Do not point the camera at the sun or a powerful LED.
Fill the frame with an evenly lit area
Too dark — move closer to the lit surface
Movement detected — keep the phone still
Flicker detected. Prolonged exposure may cause discomfort
Consider checking or replacing the light source
Measurement quality is insufficient. Try again

Frequency is the number of brightness changes per second. The flicker coefficient estimates their relative depth. The color combines both values with measurement confidence; it is not a medical or safety verdict.
An offline tool for an indicative assessment of artificial light flicker.
Results are estimates and depend on camera characteristics and measurement conditions. Use a specialized measuring device for professional verification.
